Servicing, delinquency, collections and closure

A source-linked technical walkthrough with an executable-system perspective.

After this session, you can:
  • Trace a performing and distressed account
  • Explain DPD/SMA/NPA derivation
  • Locate closure evidence

Technical flow

1. Servicing

Payments reconcile to ledger allocations; statements and change notices derive from canonical account state. Rate resets, mandate changes, prepayment and foreclosure are controlled events with borrower communications.

2. Distress

Overdue amounts derive DPD and asset classification. LWS creates collection/review work; strategy, agent assignment, conduct evidence, cash posting, hardship, restructure and recovery accounting remain linked to the account.

3. Closure

A zero economic balance is necessary but not sufficient. Closure posts the final state, releases collateral/security where relevant, produces NOC and bureau/reporting updates, and retains the full account history.
